test_title: PYST 39: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.**

It broke Eleanora's heart to see her daughter become that **(wraith)** of her former self.
solution:
The correct answer is "Spirit."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "Wraith" means a spirit of a dead person, sometimes represented as a pale, image of that person. (किसी मृत व्यक्ति की आत्मा, जिसे कभी-कभी उस व्यक्ति की पीली, पारदर्शी छवि के रूप में दर्शाया जाता है)

 
 
• Example: *A **wraith**__ is powerless in natural sunlight and will flee from it.*
 
 
 
• The most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence is **"spirit."**
 
• The word "Spirit" means the part of a person that many people believe still exists after his/her body is dead; a ghost or a being without a body. (प्रेतात्‍मा (विश्‍वास के अनुसार, मानव-शरीर की मृत्‍यु के बाद भी विद्यमान अंग); भूत या शरीर-रहित जीव)
 __
 
• Example:* It was believed that people could be possessed by evil **spirits**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Wail: **a prolonged high-pitched cry of pain, grief, or anger. (विलाप, क्रंदन, रुदन, साँय-साँय (की आवाज़))
 
• **Being: **the state of existing; existence. (अस्तित्‍व में होने की स्थिति; अस्तित्‍व, सत्ता)
 
• **Yore: **of a long time ago. (बहुत समय पहले का)

31:T931,

The correct answer is **"At time when you cannot think carefully."**
